items.reason: The HQ page has no server route or database function of its own: every one of its 40 calls goes to the HQ server's /api with the same-site sign-in cookie. The server answers /api only to the allowed owner email from the same site, and serves the HQ page itself only after sign-in; only the install files (manifest, icons, sw.js, offline page) are open. The hq_ database functions behind it are refused to apps and visitors by test 0026. Route-by-route checks were done in the server area (server/hq-gate-workers).

HQ is owner-only across all gyms, so 'another gym is refused' does not fit; checked instead that apps and strangers cannot read or call it. The page reads no table directly; the server reads through hq_ functions that test 0026 proves anon and signed-in app users cannot call, and hq_audit is read as both with rows present (0026 lines 186-191). The HQ tables only covered by the empty-table loop are already finding FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04. Default PUBLIC execute rights and definer settings were not in the machine file, so those parts rest on test 0026, not the catalog.

Rule applied: the tables reached through HQ that lack a refusal test with data in them (delete requests, support grants) are the same fault already written as FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04; no second finding.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym or stranger attempt was made against HQ.

The secret scan has no hit in apps/hq/public, and a search of the folder for key shapes and the words key, token, secret and password found only plain-English help lines. The owner's one-time sign-in code is shown once on screen and not kept in the browser (no local storage use in the folder).

No AI or other paid-service key in the HQ page: the English helper (Gemini) is called through the HQ server's /api/english/rewrite, so the key stays on the server. The page loads only its own two scripts.

Sign out only wipes the cookie in this browser, so a lost device keeps HQ for up to 30 days: already FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-02. The page sends an expired sign-in back to Google sign-in and asks for a fresh sign-in before the risky actions; the return address after sign-in is limited to this site's own paths. No PIN in HQ; sign-in is Google with one allowed email, so brute force does not apply here.

Everything members, gyms and website visitors type (feedback, leads, gym and owner names, payment notes) is put on the page as plain text, never as page code: the folder has no innerHTML or similar. Phone links always start with tel:+91, page addresses only accept a 36-character gym id or a short lower-case word, and the server sends a strict content policy (own scripts only). The gyms CSV puts a quote mark before any cell that a spreadsheet would run as a formula.
The HQ page has no file picker or upload; its only file is the CSV it downloads.

HQ addresses (#gym/<id>, #feedback/<word>) are only inside the signed-in page; guessing one gives nothing because every /api answer needs the owner's sign-in. The offline helper never stores an HQ page or answer, only the three public offline files.

The HQ page has no package of its own and loads no outside library: two own scripts importing one own file. The repo-wide npm audit rows (machine cve.json) belong to the phone app and other parts, not to this folder.
